name: Public transport
summary: Bus stops, lines and planned times for Cyprus from the national transport portal, shown on the Follow one trip page. Planned timetables only: no live buses.

el.name: Δημόσιες συγκοινωνίες
el.summary: Στάσεις, γραμμές και προγραμματισμένες ώρες λεωφορείων για την Κύπρο, από την εθνική πύλη μεταφορών, στη σελίδα «Ακολουθήστε μία διαδρομή». Μόνο προγραμματισμένα δρομολόγια: όχι ζωντανά λεωφορεία.

publisher.name: Cyprus National Access Point for transport (Public Works Department)

licence.attribution: Cyprus National Access Point for transport (traffic4cyprus.org.cy)

update.note: The portal says timetables change up to every 3 months. The server checks each file once a week and keeps the last good copy.

quality.uncertainty: Planned timetables, not what buses actually did: they can be late, and holidays and changes are not applied. Distances are straight lines from the school's place.
known_issues: A validator report shows 1 or 2 errors in some city feeds
Not yet confirmed from the real files: line drawings (shapes), and whether stop names are Greek, English or both

restrictions: The live bus feed (GTFS-Realtime) is not used: it is plain HTTP on a bare IP address and could show where our own buses are
Credit the portal (CC BY 4.0) wherever this data is shown, and say that it was reduced to stops, lines and times

use_for: Which bus stops and lines are near a school
Planned first and last bus of a line
not_for: Where a bus is right now, or whether it is late

notes: Static GTFS only, read by gtfs.js and served at /api/transit. The download addresses (motionbuscard.org.cy, files 2, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10 and 11) come from research notes and have not been opened from the server yet: check the Railway log after the deploy. The brain does not read this layer (x_reads).
